title: Walking runs smoother on low-powered computers
items: On a low-powered computer, such as one with built-in graphics, the picture is drawn a little softer while you move, and the sun's shadows refresh every other frame.
Walking 1904 on a test computer of this class went from about 10 to about 12 frames a second.
When you stop, the view is back at full sharpness with every shadow, and nobody in town is left out.
